### What can I do?
#### 1\. Prepare
If you're financially able, order your documents now to avoid rush processing and shipping fees. Many states use [VitalChek](https://substack.com/redirect/1066e69b-4195-45aa-8568-fd19f968ba41?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) if you can't travel to the appropriate office in person.
You will likely need certified copies of:
* Your birth certificate
* Each marriage license
* Each divorce decree
* Any death certificate if you were widowed and changed your name afterward

Once you have everything, get yourself a fireproof bag or safe to store these documents once you have them.
#### 2\. Check your registration
Voting purges are increasingly common. This bill relies on people not checking their registration status and not understanding how the SAVE Act could affect them--setting the stage for ballot denials on Election Day due to name conflicts.
Your polling place may also change. Our pal [Erica Laughing](https://open.substack.com/users/15860769-erica-laughing?utm_source=mentions) has lived in the same building for 19 years and her polling place has changed five times. Guess how many times she's been notified? (Hint: it's zero.)
**And even if you are currently registered, get your documents anyway.**
If you're challenged at the polls, you should be able to produce certified originals and demand your ballot.
#### 3\. Inform!
Tell every married woman, adoptee, transgender person, and anyone who has legally changed their name in your circle what is happening.
Educate the men in your life, too. Make sure they understand that their wives, mothers, and sisters stand to lose their right to vote.
[Share this article](https://substack.com/redirect/1fe67915-656e-4b7e-b818-69e666adbc9f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Talk about it. We cannot afford to assume people already know.
#### 4\. Contact your Senators
The SAVE Act has passed the House and now sits in the Senate. There is no official date for a floor vote yet, but this is the moment to apply pressure.
[Call your Senators](https://substack.com/redirect/65c548c1-7a34-4052-bf90-13d7049b0819?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). [Email them](https://substack.com/redirect/65c548c1-7a34-4052-bf90-13d7049b0819?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Tell them to vote **NO** on the SAVE Act.
#### 5\. VOTE
Get your documents in order. Bring them with you on Election Day. Exercise this hard-won right that millions of women before you did not have.
You're not only representing yourself. You're standing in for countless women who never had a voice.
**Honor them.**
Do your democratic duty. Go out and vote, and make sure as many people in your immediate circle do the same.

### **Tell every woman you know: Our vote is at risk!**
**The suffragettes didn 't ask politely for the right to vote. They demanded it. They endured ridicule, arrest, and violence to secure it.**
Now that right is threatened and we have to fight again. Not with clubs or chains, but with forms and fees.
If the SAVE Act becomes law, millions of women will lose their right to vote, but not because they're ineligible. They'll lose it because they complied. Because they married. Because they changed their names. Because they followed the rules.
That's not election security.
That's voter suppression.
And it's on us to stop it.

Because Congress may not need to repeal the 19th Amendment to achieve the same result. They have the SAVE Act for that. We can't let that happen. What can I do? 1\. Prepare If you're financially able, order your documents now to avoid rush processing and shipping fees. Many states use if you can't travel to the appropriate office in person. You will likely need certified copies of: Your birth certificate Each marriage license Each divorce decree Any death certificate if you were widowed and changed your name afterward Once you have everything, get yourself a fireproof bag or safe to store these documents once you have them. 2\. Check your registration Voting purges are increasingly common. This bill relies on people not checking their registration status and not understanding how the SAVE Act could affect them--setting the stage for ballot denials on Election Day due to name conflicts. Your polling place may also change. Our pal has lived in the same building for 19 years and her polling place has changed five times. Guess how many times she's been notified? (Hint: it's zero.) And even if you are currently registered, get your documents anyway. If you're challenged at the polls, you should be able to produce certified originals and demand your ballot. 3\. Inform! Tell every married woman, adoptee, transgender person, and anyone who has legally changed their name in your circle what is happening. Educate the men in your life, too. Make sure they understand that their wives, mothers, and sisters stand to lose their right to vote. . Talk about it. We cannot afford to assume people already know. 4\. Contact your Senators The SAVE Act has passed the House and now sits in the Senate. There is no official date for a floor vote yet, but this is the moment to apply pressure. . . Tell them to vote NO on the SAVE Act. 5\. VOTE Get your documents in order. Bring them with you on Election Day. Exercise this hard-won right that millions of women before you did not have. You're not only representing yourself. You're standing in for countless women who never had a voice. Honor them. Do your democratic duty. Go out and vote, and make sure as many people in your immediate circle do the same. Tell every woman you know: Our vote is at risk! The suffragettes didn 't ask politely for the right to vote. They demanded it. They endured ridicule, arrest, and violence to secure it. Now that right is threatened and we have to fight again. Not with clubs or chains, but with forms and fees. If the SAVE Act becomes law, millions of women will lose their right to vote, but not because they're ineligible. They'll lose it because they complied. Because they married. Because they changed their names. Because they followed the rules. That's not election security. That's voter suppression. And it's on us to stop it. | | ---|---|--- About the authors is a GenX word nerd living in the Pacific Northwest. She's the co-host of and Editorial Director at . She writes across a variety of topics but parenting, music and pop culture, relationships, and feminism are her favorites. Em-dashes, Oxford commas, and well-placed semi-colons make her heart happy. name: Mark Kelly
subject: My decision:
body:
Hey, it’s
Mark Kelly.

Seven years ago, I was making a decision about whether I was going to run
for the Senate.

I knew it would be a lot of work. A lot of time away from home. A lot of
time away from family. I knew it wouldn’t be easy.

But after two years of Donald Trump and a Republican-held Senate doing
just about everything he wanted, I knew I couldn’t sit on the sidelines. I
had to do something.

So, I ran. And, somehow, we won. And then we had to turn around and run
all over again to win a full term after that. But thanks to your support,
we won that one, too.

I’m grateful every day that I get to wake up, walk out the door, and
defend our people, our democracy, and our Constitution. It’s one of the
greatest honors of my life. And I’ve never forgotten that I wouldn’t be
here without your help.

We’ve been in some tough fights before, but this one is different. The
President of the United States threatened my life, personally. I’ve got
the full weight of the executive branch bearing down on me right now.

After everything you’ve already done for me, I shouldn’t have to ask you
for more. But that’s what I need to do.

Peter,
Are you sick and tired of Trump embarrassing us on the world stage?
Us too.
Are you tired of watching him threaten to invade Greenland, Venezuela, and Cuba while our allies look on in horror?
Us too.
Are you tired of MAGA undermining our democracy, threatening to send jackbooted ICE goons to "surround" voting places and intimidate Americans exercising their constitutional rights?
Us too.
Are you tired of Republicans gerrymandering their way to power so they never have to answer to voters no matter how unpopular they become?
Us too.
And are you tired - absolutely exhausted - of Democrats following the same old, same old playbook when this moment calls for so much more?
Us too.
That's why we launched Colorado Draws the Line.
Because being "right" doesn't matter if you lose. Taking the high road doesn't matter if it leads you off a cliff. Playing by rules that Republicans abandoned years ago doesn't make you noble--it makes you a sucker.
MAGA isn't playing by the old rules, and neither are we.
We're here to WIN BACK SEATS for Democrats and help put an end to the MAGA Majority that is failing us.
Our ballot initiative will flip 3-4 congressional seats in Colorado--potentially including Lauren Boebert's--and give Democrats a real shot at retaking the House in 2026. That means investigations into Trump's corruption. Subpoena power to uncover what they're hiding. The ability to actually STOP his authoritarian power grabs instead of just tweeting about them.
But it only works if Democrats across the country step up and fight like our democracy depends on it.

| Peter,
The gloves are off. MAGA said it loud and proud
On the heels of Donald Trump openly threatening to have MAGA nationalize elections, his longtime advisor and MAGA mouthpiece, Steve Bannon, revealed Trump's most insidious election rigging plot yet:
---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001SOtG7zAJGkH7M3yp6lVPHviC1LFFKCu6U2VuH9C9M1RSWatdfD1WcVz2EwmjV1z7PWOd9HusmIK4S4PHxpY2wONH_OjycQPgAK0W0ze5uk1BI_ROpqu84fdmS-afjbanrpOE0KLDneUUF9-9bpfpwykVaftwDc14PJijVL0tIiVWGptlH1Z0NIpM5PCSQIRBNO_9iUF_2bohJwLnFGTJ0iffiUVsSrJbbNtmSkiW9gg=&c=oCNzDxlVOFn3tVwU9COZ6fHkfwDlhKw6KTj_faOHdZYIm-yAaNHKRg==&ch=X3rTcg1Q_t5AV911YIgtHB5T7PNWW2aD7oMN2stRo7gdtAw0_Cw4vQ==)
---
MAGA has declared war against free and fair elections.
For months, Defend Our Courts has warned that MAGA was plotting to rig upcoming elections by any means possible. What Bannon revealed confirms exactly the type of extreme measures that we feared: they are preparing to use federal force to interfere with voting itself.
MAGA knows it is headed for major losses if elections remain free and fair. Instead of changing course, it is choosing coercion. Instead of persuasion, it is choosing fear.
And it's important to be clear about how this works.
In most states, the presence of law enforcement at polling places is tightly regulated--or prohibited entirely--by state law. The authority to stop voter intimidation does not come from Washington. It comes from state courts, and ultimately from state Supreme Courts.
That is why MAGA's long-term strategy has focused on capturing those courts. This is not new. This is the next phase.
Last year, Defend Our Courts helped lead the successful defense of the Pennsylvania Supreme Court--a critical firewall in the most important swing state in the country. That victory wasn't symbolic. It protected the court that would have final say over election disputes in 2026 and beyond.
Now MAGA is escalating nationwide.
In 2026, state Supreme Court elections will take place in Michigan, Wisconsin, and Georgia--the very states where voter intimidation would be most consequential, and where courts will be called on to intervene if MAGA follows through on its threats.
This is why Defend Our Courts exists. We saw what was coming early. We rallied over 100 thousand Democrats to support our cause and built a winning model in Pennsylvania.
Now we are taking our winning formula national. With Democrats stretched thin by House and Senate races, defending democracy in the courts will not happen unless we do it.

subject: Congressional Forum Set For February 9
body:
The leading candidates for the 3rd Congressional District seat presently held by retiring Rep. Dwight Evans will meet in a forum. | | | |
---
| | | [ ](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=73d5377250&e=b7b3eddce2)
---
| **Congressional Forum Set For Feb. 9 in Rittenhouse Square**
---
| The leading candidates for the 3rd Congressional District seat presently held by retiring Rep. Dwight Evans will meet in a forum on Monday, Feb. 9, at the [Church of the Holy Trinity](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=86049f0150&e=b7b3eddce2) on Rittenhouse Square in Philadelphia. The event is hosted by [PoliticsPA](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=407d6e009a&e=b7b3eddce2), in partnership with the [Center City Residents’ Association](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=8114dbc059&e=b7b3eddce2) (CCRA), and sister news-site [PhillyDaily](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=62dfec7c95&e=b7b3eddce2). The forum begins at 7 p.m. and is [open to the public](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=79be670742&e=b7b3eddce2). [Thirteen candidates have filed their candidacy with the FEC](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=3b3a2eea34&e=b7b3eddce2), including Democrats State Sen. Sharif Street, State Rep. Chris Rabb, State Rep. Morgan Cephas, Dr. Dave Oxman, Dr. Ala Stanford, Karl Morris, Cole Carter, NaDerah Griffin, Jahmiel Jackson, Pablo McConnie-Saad, Isaiah Martin, Robin Toldens, and Republican Sheila Armstrong. The forum is expected to last approximately 90 minutes and will include candidates who have registered the highest fundraising and public polling numbers available. Moderators include Gina Ceisler Shapiro, CCRA Executive Vice President; Dick Polman, veteran national political columnist; and Steve Ulrich, managing editor of PoliticsPA. The 3rd District includes several areas of the city of Philadelphia – America’s sixth-largest city – including West Philadelphia, most of Center City, and parts of North Philadelphia. The candidates are vying to replace Evans, who announced his retirement from the U.S. House at the conclusion of this term. Evans was elected to the seat in a special election in 2016 after serving as a Pennsylvania state representative for decades.
PoliticsPA and PhillyDaily, both powered by the [Fideri News Network](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=1167ffe322&e=b7b3eddce2), will simulcast the event across the network’s local news sites, broadcast radio, and multimedia platforms. The [Pennsylvania Cable Network](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=4bbe10a10c&e=b7b3eddce2) (PCN) will also air the forum throughout the Commonwealth. Serving as the voice of Center City West since 1947, the Center City Residents’ Association promotes urban living; advocates for a clean, diverse and supportive community; pursues accountability; and encourages responsible development while preserving the neighborhood’s historic heritage. [PoliticsPA](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=236800d0db&e=b7b3eddce2) is Pennsylvania’s premier source for nonpartisan political news and analysis. Since its founding in 2001, PoliticsPA has served as a go-to resource for elected officials, campaign professionals, journalists, and politically engaged citizens across the Commonwealth. The Fideri News Network boasts Pennsylvania’s largest native digital media audience. The network champions events that drive robust community engagement, support civic dialogue, and fulfill the uniquely American ideals of a free and independent press. The event is open to all media. What: PA-03 Congressional Forum
When: Monday, February 9, 2026 at 7 p.m.
Where: Church of the Holy Trinity, 1904 Walnut Street, Philadelphia.
Contacts: Gina Ceisler Shapiro, CCRA Executive Vice President; Steve Ulrich, Managing Editor, PoliticsPA
---
|
---

|
---
| **In Case You Missed It...**
---
| The _Voices of Reason_ podcast has covered the most important issues in Pennsylvania politics – from [education funding](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=a424505756&e=b7b3eddce2) to [trust in elections](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=a790a36813&e=b7b3eddce2). Secretary of the Commonwealth [Al Schmidt](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=a71ad3b910&e=b7b3eddce2), PA Treasurer [Stacy Garrity](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=d26ab6cfc1&e=b7b3eddce2), and House Appropriations Chairman [Jordan Harris](https://onpattison.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=e96839fb85&e=b7b3eddce2) are just a few of many influential guests who have joined us for exclusive interviews and roundtable discussions.

| | Charlie Kirk lived fast. And he lived loud.

He filled arenas. He lit a fire in the next generation on campus.

He confronted lies and spoke truth with boldness.

And he built a movement and a machine that few ever thought possible.

I saw it up close -- _Charlie moved at a pace most couldn 't keep up with. _

But in the middle of all the noise... he made a quiet decision that changed everything.

_**He started observing the Sabbath. **_

Not as a box to check. Not as a religious performance.

_But as an act of obedience. _

As a way of saying, **_" God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold." _**

Every week -- no matter what -- Charlie stopped.

He turned off the noise. He stepped away from the battlefield.

No email. No media. No work.

He gave his full attention fully to God, his wife Erika, and his children.

It was hard at first -- for someone who carried so much.

But over time, it changed him.

And before he was assassinated, he wrote a book about what he had learned...

He confronted lies and spoke truth with boldness. And he built a movement and a machine that few ever thought possible. I saw it up close -- Charlie moved at a pace most couldn 't keep up with. But in the middle of all the noise... he made a quiet decision that changed everything. He started observing the Sabbath. Not as a box to check. Not as a religious performance. But as an act of obedience. As a way of saying, " God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold." Every week -- no matter what -- Charlie stopped. He turned off the noise. He stepped away from the battlefield. No email. No media. No work. He gave his full attention fully to God, his wife Erika, and his children. It was hard at first -- for someone who carried so much. But over time, it changed him. And before he was assassinated, he wrote a book about what he had learned... This was Charlie's final message. His final act of trust. A book not about politics... but about peace. It 's called: Stop, in the Name of God. Fellow Patriot, like I mentioned, this isn't a political book. It's not a culture war manifesto. It's a call to stop. To rest. To breathe. To return to God. Because Charlie believed America hadn 't just forgotten truth... It had forgotten trust. Trust that the world keeps spinning when you step away. Trust that God is in control. Trust that rest is not weakness -- it's worship. In Stop, in the Name of God, you'll discover: 🔥 How Charlie reclaimed the Sabbath in a world built on burnout 🔥 What sacred rest gave back to him -- as a father, husband, and believer 🔥 Why he believed this message could spark revival in a restless generation Charlie wrote this book because he knew what it meant to nearly lose his peace -- and what it felt like to find it again. body:

HuffPost: Mail-In Voters Could Face A New Obstacle This Midterm Season [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=020526_1&amount=25]
Team: Changes at the U.S. Postal Service are going to make a known problem even worse, and it could affect thousands of voters across the country in this November’s midterm elections.
Legally speaking, the date stamped on your mail is when it counts as being sent, from your bills to your taxes to your ballot. For decades, that's been stamped the day you gave it to the United States Postal Service (USPS), whether you handed it to your mail carrier, left it in a mailbox, or dropped it at the local post office.
That's no longer the case. Your mail will be stamped the day it hits a regional processing facility , not your local post office. That could be a day, or more, later than when you handed your mail over, thanks to the Trump administration's "cost-cutting" efforts.
How does this impact vote-by-mail? If you live in a state with a mail-in ballot grace period -- something most states still have, even though MAGA is trying to end those -- your ballot still counts if it was postmarked by Election Day and received in the grace period after Election Day. In this case, however, a ballot mailed on Election Day may not be postmarked as Election Day, making your ballot automatically invalid even though you followed the rule of law and the postmark date is out of your control.
We have to make sure every voter understands this change and how it can impact them -- from vote-by-mail, to their bills, their taxes, legal replies to companies, everything. What Americans think is the mailing deadline may not be the deadline anymore and that's a huge deal that's being under-reported by the media.

We're worried about every mail-in voter getting their ballot in on time, but especially those most vulnerable to this change, like the elderly, rural Americans who live far from USPS regional facilities, our military service members, and young people who are voting by mail away from home. clean_body: Voter Action Project [] HuffPost: Mail-In Voters Could Face A New Obstacle This Midterm Season [] Team: Changes at the U.S. Postal Service are going to make a known problem even worse, and it could affect thousands of voters across the country in this November’s midterm elections. Legally speaking, the date stamped on your mail is when it counts as being sent, from your bills to your taxes to your ballot. For decades, that's been stamped the day you gave it to the United States Postal Service (USPS), whether you handed it to your mail carrier, left it in a mailbox, or dropped it at the local post office. That's no longer the case. Your mail will be stamped the day it hits a regional processing facility , not your local post office. That could be a day, or more, later than when you handed your mail over, thanks to the Trump administration's "cost-cutting" efforts. How does this impact vote-by-mail? If you live in a state with a mail-in ballot grace period -- something most states still have, even though MAGA is trying to end those -- your ballot still counts if it was postmarked by Election Day and received in the grace period after Election Day. In this case, however, a ballot mailed on Election Day may not be postmarked as Election Day, making your ballot automatically invalid even though you followed the rule of law and the postmark date is out of your control. We have to make sure every voter understands this change and how it can impact them -- from vote-by-mail, to their bills, their taxes, legal replies to companies, everything. What Americans think is the mailing deadline may not be the deadline anymore and that's a huge deal that's being under-reported by the media. Look, being a former Republican isn’t my whole story.
My mother immigrated from the Philippines as an organic chemist. I followed in her footsteps and majored in biochemistry before I went to Law School to pursue my true passion – Constitutional Law.
Looking back, the Constitution was my first love. At 10, I was obsessed with the Watergate Scandal. ( Little did I know that was child's play compared to what Trump would do ).
I know that sounds boring and nerdy, but the promise of our democracy, freedoms, and the rule of law fascinates me – and for years I thought Republicans upheld those same ideals.
I was so wrong. When I finally got a peek under the hood and saw what these lying, sleazebag, horrible MAGA loyalists were doing to our country, I couldn’t stomach it.
Let me be straight with you: Republicans are failing America, and as someone who’s been fighting Trump for years, I know exactly how to stop them.
It requires not running the same plays, election after election, hoping we’ll see different results. It means being bold and not afraid to fight fire with fire – like I’ve been doing at the cost of my career and reputation.
Look, Democrats’ success last November proved there’s hope. Trump may think he’s a king on a throne, but his wannabe dictatorship is built on a house of cards, and we are this close to toppling it.
If we can take back Congress for Democrats, we can cut Trump’s MAGA agenda off at the knees. To do it, we need a fearless candidate who knows what makes the MAGA machine tick, and who can rewrite the playbook and WIN.

name: Hoosiers for Haggard
subject: Talking about 1333
body:
Why I voted the way I did

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/f6d285ad5eef/talking-about-1333?e=72dace1453)
---
|
---
|
---
| | | | |
---
| |
# Time to Talk About 1333
---
|
---
| |
To the people of Indiana,

I want to be very clear about my position on House Bill 1333.

As the bill currently sits, it is not a good bill, and if it returns to the House without meaningful changes, I will vote against it. I recognize its shortcomings, and I want Hoosiers to know that I am not satisfied with the bill in its current form.

From the very beginning of the legislative session, the bill’s author has worked to add critical amendment language that would strengthen the bill and protect local communities. While those amendments were unsuccessful on the House side, my understanding is that this language will be added in the Senate.

With that amendment in place, counties would have full authority and veto power over projects coming into their communities. If a county does not believe a project is right for them, they would have the final say. I have always voted for — and will always support — local control, and that principle is non-negotiable for me.

The intent of House Bill 1333 has never been to punish economic development. The intent has always been to preserve Indiana’s best farmland, encourage companies to use brownfields or low-yield land, and ensure development happens responsibly. It was also the intent of the bill to recapture 1% of the state sales tax abatement and return those funds directly to counties, giving local governments more resources and flexibility.

It is important to emphasize that the House did not vote on a final bill. We voted on a bill that is still in the process of being improved. That process matters. However, let me be clear: if this bill does not reach the point where it truly protects farmland, respects local authority, and delivers real benefits to counties, we will kill it.

I will continue to fight for Indiana’s farmers, local governments, and communities, and I will not support legislation that falls short of those values.

Respectfully,

Craig Haggard
Indiana State Representative

---
|
---
| | I also was able to celebrate my retirement ceremony at the statehouse. After 4 great years, I wanted to thank you for voting for me these last few years and I hope I can get your vote again this May for Congress.
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| |
---
|

clean_body: Why I voted the way I did | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Time to Talk About 1333 | | | To the people of Indiana, I want to be very clear about my position on House Bill 1333. As the bill currently sits, it is not a good bill, and if it returns to the House without meaningful changes, I will vote against it. I recognize its shortcomings, and I want Hoosiers to know that I am not satisfied with the bill in its current form. From the very beginning of the legislative session, the bill’s author has worked to add critical amendment language that would strengthen the bill and protect local communities. While those amendments were unsuccessful on the House side, my understanding is that this language will be added in the Senate. With that amendment in place, counties would have full authority and veto power over projects coming into their communities. If a county does not believe a project is right for them, they would have the final say. I have always voted for — and will always support — local control, and that principle is non-negotiable for me. The intent of House Bill 1333 has never been to punish economic development. The intent has always been to preserve Indiana’s best farmland, encourage companies to use brownfields or low-yield land, and ensure development happens responsibly. It was also the intent of the bill to recapture 1% of the state sales tax abatement and return those funds directly to counties, giving local governments more resources and flexibility. It is important to emphasize that the House did not vote on a final bill. We voted on a bill that is still in the process of being improved. That process matters. However, let me be clear: if this bill does not reach the point where it truly protects farmland, respects local authority, and delivers real benefits to counties, we will kill it. I will continue to fight for Indiana’s farmers, local governments, and communities, and I will not support legislation that falls short of those values. Respectfully, Craig Haggard Indiana State Representative | | | I also was able to celebrate my retirement ceremony at the statehouse. After 4 great years, I wanted to thank you for voting for me these last few years and I hope I can get your vote again this May for Congress. | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | I will continue highlighting the endorsements I continue to receive throughout the district from local leaders and groups that put their faith in me to represent them in Congress. # **Call you state Senator**
---
| |
| | | Even as South Carolina’s [**maternal mortality rate**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=8020a15927&e=edbde6c9b1) continues to rise, lawmakers are advancing House Bill 4760 – a dangerous bill that would**restrict access to medications for abortion, emergency miscarriage care, treatment for postpartum hemorrhage, routine labor and delivery care, and even treatment for common conditions like ulcers and arthritis.**
Earlier today, this bill passed the South Carolina House of Representatives. Now, this cruel bill moves to the Senate. **This threat to our care is real and moving fast.**
**Here’s how you can fight back against H. 4760:**
---
| |
* [**Email:**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=05afc8fcf7&e=edbde6c9b1) Send a quick, pre-written message to your state senator.
* [**Call:**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=0d514a7f6a&e=edbde6c9b1) Fill out the form to be immediately connected to your state senator.
* [**Show Up:**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=33e4e77800&e=edbde6c9b1) Join us for Reproductive Health Advocacy Day on February 24, where we’ll meet with legislators to discuss the attacks on our health care.

---
|

# **Contact your congressperson and demand they vote no on DHS funding bill**
---
| |
**There are only nine days to go, so we need to act quickly.** Contact your Members of Congress and demand they vote no on any DHS funding bill unless, at a minimum, it:
* Pulls ICE and Border Patrol out of Minneapolis and the rest of our communities
* Prevents ICE or Border Patrol enforcement at designated "sensitive locations" such as houses of worship, day cares, and hospitals
* Restricts ICE and Border Patrol’s ability to target people based on their race, language or accent, place of employment, or location at the time of the apprehension
* Ends the administration’s unlawful practice of warrantless home entry and arrests

**Use our updated call scripts and email tool to contact your Members of Congress today:** [**Call your senators.**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=bcc3c7348c&e=edbde6c9b1)****[**Call your representative.**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=fd63f3ebd7&e=edbde6c9b1)****[**Email your Members of Congress**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=cd6c98b466&e=edbde6c9b1) to drive the point home. [**Check out our explainer**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=0abd55338b&e=edbde6c9b1) for the latest updates, our full list of demands, and answers to common questions about ICE/CBP funding and a potential shutdown.Keep the pressure on Congress - call you Congressman!
GOP state reps have introduced a bill -- H. 4764 -- to require every county sheriff in the state to agree to a cooperation agreement with ICE. It's bad enough that the Spartanburg County Sheriff's Department last summer signed just such an agreement with ICE. We cannot allow ICE to have a foothold in our state.
There are two things we can do right now: Push county council to rescind the current cooperation agreement. The next meeting is February 16. Fight to get H. 4764 permanently tabled. Call or write to all the members of the state house, Rep Rosalyn Henderson Myers & Travis Moore are on the judiciary committee. [**https://docs.google.com/.../1FdGQGDXSx8z8ap3.../edit...**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=3838dad572&e=edbde6c9b1)

| |
This past week we attended the OneSpartanburg Legislative Outlook where we were forced to sit through 30 minutes of [Congressman Timmons ](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=d2f75b87fa&e=edbde6c9b1)telling bold faced lies about the administration, calling himself a victim of the housing market, taking us on a weird journey about the health industry, and then ending with defending ICE for murdering two people in Minneapolis. He even admitted Congress has totally lost power and self described his presentation as sounding like an asshole. Don’t believe me - here is the recording. [Timmons Recording](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=6f964730bf&e=edbde6c9b1)
Disgraced Senator Josh Kimbrell who is under investigation by the FBI while running for Governor then proceeded to blow hot air for another 30 minutes about his plan for income taxes before he finally and with much fluff and flip flop addressed our measles outbreak. Both officials complained about the gridlock of their legislative bodies because of the very extremist landscape they aided and abetted.
I then joined my parents for the ICE OUT protest downtown and spent the rest of the weekend in the snow with friends and pups.
Stay with me y’all, democracy is a participatory sport.

# [](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/131?refcode=em20260205-136&t=1&akid=136%2E12592%2EEmLEc_)
**“April 21st is our line in the sand”**
That’s how former Virginia Governor Terry McAuliffe [put it on _X_](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/363?t=2&akid=136%2E12592%2EEmLEc_) — urging Virginians to show up and defend the integrity of our elections:

He’s right. And he’s standing with us.
This amendment is about putting power where it belongs: with Virginia voters. It ensures transparency, accountability, and giving Virginians a real say in how congressional maps are drawn. It secures fair elections and makes sure voters’ voices are reflected in who represents them.
With our former governor speaking out, and national momentum growing, _this moment matters_. But public support alone won’t pass this amendment. We need resources to mobilize voters, spread the word, and win in April.

Thanks so much, null.
Haley

From: **Haley S.**

[](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/13726?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&t=4&akid=2155%2E49239%2EATZXEs)
Hi null, it’s Haley – just thinking back on my _Made in Michigan_ tour last year.
I had the chance to speak with so many incredible Michiganders, and each conversation reminded me why I’m running for Senate: to fight for the hardworking people who make this state great.
But I can’t talk to everyone in person, and that’s why I’m reaching out: **[Will you take 60 seconds to fill out my Priorities Survey?](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/13726?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&t=5&akid=2155%2E49239%2EATZXEs)**
| | [TAKE THE SURVEY](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/13726?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&t=6&akid=2155%2E49239%2EATZXEs)
---
From rising costs to protecting Social Security to defending Michigan’s manufacturing jobs, I’ve heard a lot about what is keeping people up at night. But I genuinely want to know:**What’s on YOUR mind, null?**
[**We’re hoping to get 100 responses from 18326 before midnight tonight –** can I count on you to take the survey now?](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/13726?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&t=7&akid=2155%2E49239%2EATZXEs)
Grateful you're on this team,

Haley
|

**A note from Haley Stevens:** null, I’m proud to be a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. That’s why I’ve fought so hard for working families my entire life. Now, I’m running for Michigan’s open Senate seat to continue fighting for the people and communities I love. The path to the Senate majority runs right through Michigan, which means this race is shaping up to be the most competitive and expensive in the entire country. The GOP is already coming after me as a top target for defeat, so I’m counting on your grassroots support to fight back and win. [**If you’re in this fight with me, will you add your name to endorse my campaign?**](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/13728?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&t=8&akid=2155%2E49239%2EATZXEs) | | | [](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/13727?t=9&akid=2155%2E49239%2EATZXEs)

Haley

clean_body: | I recently returned home to LA after meeting one of our incredible JanePAC-endorsed candidates: Eli Savit for Michigan Attorney General. He’s an incredible leader, and I’m excited to tell you more about him. = It’s impossible to look away from what’s happening across our country. Donald Trump and his MAGA machine are ripping apart federal protections piece by piece — gutting climate safeguards, unleashing ICE to terrorize our communities, tear-gassing children, and openly threatening to “take over voting” when elections don’t go their way. Laws are being ignored. Power is being abused. And the message from the top is clear: there will be no guardrails unless we build them ourselves. That’s why I’m giving this race everything I’ve got. State Attorneys General have become one of our last and strongest lines of defense against authoritarianism and the corporate polluters backing it. = | = Let me explain why I'm going all-in for Eli: 1️⃣ Michigan is ground zero for climate justice. The Great Lakes state holds 90% of the nation's freshwater supply. Climate change is already devastating vulnerable communities, and Detroit has experienced multiple catastrophic floods in recent years, disproportionately harming lower-income residents. Michigan needs an AG who will fight for environmental justice. 2️⃣ Eli has spent his entire career taking on polluters. He's won major settlements against PFAS contamination. He created Michigan's only Economic Justice Unit to hold corporations accountable. And he's been an outspoken critic of fossil fuel money corrupting politics. This fight is personal for him. 3️⃣ He'll be a firewall against Trump's dangerous agenda. Eli will fight Trump's attempts to gut the Endangerment Finding, block efforts to keep aging coal plants open, and make corporate polluters pay for climate damages. And he'll use every legal tool available to protect Michigan families from Trump's authoritarian overreach. And in case that's not enough to convince you to support Eli, know this: Michigan Democrats broke a 16-year Republican hold on this seat in 2018. Eli is fighting to protect it, and he's standing up to Trump while he does it. That's the kind of integrity we need, but it also means his campaign depends entirely on grassroots supporters like you. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = ---|--- = | = = | = In solidarity, xx Jane = | Follow along: | | | | | | ---|---|---|---|---|--- Paid for by Jane Fonda Climate PAC, not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee. body:
District 30 deserves representation rooted in the lived realities of everyday people.
#
[](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260205-fh.4gEXhv&refcode=em20260205-37436&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=37436%2E1203867%2EP39OFO)
Hi Peter, this is Reverend Frederick Haynes III, Democratic candidate for Congress in Texas’s 30th district.
**It’s an honor to be endorsed by Justice Democrats** , and I'm grateful to stand in community with this movement to ensure we build a team in Congress that puts the voices of working people over the interests of lobbyists and billionaire donors.
**[Before I tell you more about myself, can you split a donation to my campaign and Justice Democrats right now?](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260205-fh.4gEXhv&refcode=em20260205-37436&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=37436%2E1203867%2EP39OFO)** This primary is less than a month away, so there’s no time to waste!
For the last four decades, I’ve served the people of Dallas as a faith-rooted servant leader and senior pastor, community advocate, and coalition-builder committed to justice, opportunity, accountability, and the people.
Leadership matters, and my life’s work has prepared me to lead with courage and a relentless commitment to the people — because the people deserve nothing less.
**I’m running for Congress because the 30th Congressional District deserves representation rooted in the lived realities of everyday people** , not corporate talking points, political convenience, or systems that benefit the few while extracting from the many.
I bring an outside vision, one forged by organizing, listening, building coalitions, confronting injustice, and standing with working families. Not shaped by lobbyists, but by seniors choosing between medicine and rent, students burdened by debt, parents navigating underfunded schools, and communities pushed to the margins by policy decisions made far away from their everyday lives.
**“We outside” is more than a phrase; it’s a declaration.** It means bringing the voices of working people, faith leaders, community advocates, students, and the underserved into Congress and turning real-life experience into real policy that delivers dignity, opportunity, security, and lasting change for all.
**Right now, affordability is only for the up-and-in, not the down-and-out.** In Washington, I will fight to invest in a living wage and economic opportunity, affordable homes, successful schools, and healthcare for all. I will also fight to abolish ICE, stop the genocide in Gaza, and end the environmental racism making our communities sick.
This campaign is about prioritizing people over politics, service over slogans, and results over rhetoric. That’s why **I’m refusing corporate PAC money** , and why I’m counting on this grassroots movement to come through and help us build a winning campaign.
**[Can you chip in $5 or whatever is meaningful to you to bring the working-class voices, vision, and values of TX-30 to Congress?](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260205-fh.4gEXhv&refcode=em20260205-37436&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=4&akid=37436%2E1203867%2EP39OFO)**
**[Contribute $5](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260205-fh.4gEXhv&refcode=em20260205-37436&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=23&akid=37436%2E1203867%2EP39OFO)**
Together, we will ensure that the needs of our community are not just heard but acted upon.
With gratitude,
Rev. Frederick Haynes

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20260205-37436-footer&t=24&refcode2=37436_1203867_P39OFO&akid=37436%2E1203867%2EP39OFO)**

**GOV. SPANBERGER ENDS AGREEMENT BETWEEN STATE AND ICE** Gov. Abigail Spanberger has formally ended the 287(g) agreement that mandated state law enforcement agencies cooperate with federal Immigration and Customs Enforcement efforts. This is a basic first step toward restoring our constitutional protections and rebuilding trust between immigrant communities and law enforcement in our Commonwealth.

**BILLS TO LOWER ENERGY COSTS FOR AEP CUSTOMERS ADVANCE** Single family homes should not have monthly power bills nearing a thousand dollars. We have found that Appalachian Power customers pay more than anyone else in the Commonwealth - we are going to change that. Our bipartisan bills are making their way through the legislature to address outrageous electric bills.

I’ll tell you what else is no laughing matter: the issues Coloradans are facing all across our state.
We’ve heard from thousands of Coloradans — on our Fight for Colorado Town Hall Tour, in our suggestion box, and all over — about the biggest concerns they have. Just a few common themes have been around affordability, defending our democracy, and building opportunity for all through support for our public schools and our workforce.
Questions, concerns, and feedback like the ones I’ve mentioned are _always_ valuable to me, because they come right from you: the people I’m here to serve. **Our campaign is not — and will never be — bankrolled by out-of-state billionaires, corporations, or special interests._I will never let their dollars hijack the agenda we’ve built together._ That’s why I have never taken, and never will take, corporate money or PAC money in my campaigns.**

Friend,

In less than two weeks, millions of people will gather to watch the biggest football game of the year. **Bright lights.**
**Packed hotels.** **Most people don't know this...** Wherever crowds gather, traffickers follow. Major sporting weekends bring increased travel, full hotels, busy airports, and distracted attention. **Behind the excitement ...**
**Children will go missing.** This is the perfect environment for exploitation. Law enforcement and child protection organizations know this pattern well. **Trafficking spikes around large events because vulnerability increases. **While millions are preparing for entertainment, vulnerable children are facing danger. They're not thinking about scores or highlights, but hoping to be safe - waiting for help before harm happens. This is why this moment matters. Here is a truth that should stop us cold: **9 out of 10 missing children are trafficked right here in the United States.** That's why I'm reaching out to you today. The**Sound of Freedom Foundation** exists to interrupt these moments of danger with protection, prevention, and action. We are not here for awareness alone.Awareness without action does not save a child. We are here to stop trafficking before it starts, support intervention efforts, and protect children when the risk is highest. **But this mission is not an idea. ****It is personal. **
**It is lived. **
**It is carried by those who know danger firsthand.**
---

My name is Theresa Flores. I'm a survivor of child trafficking. And today, I work to help protect children **before they disappear.** **I was fifteen years old. **
**An honor student. **
**A daughter. ** A girl who trusted the wrong "friend." **I was trafficked for two years.**

Most people imagine trafficking happens far away...in dark alleys...in other countries.

To "other people." **But that's not how it usually happens.** Right now, as set up for the big game is underway, **120 trained partner volunteers are already on the ground in the Bay Area**. Men and women working _this week_ --
Training hotel staff to recognize danger. Walking hotel halls, parking garages and public spaces. **Watching.**
**Reporting.**
**Protecting.** **Standing where traffickers don't expect resistance.** Children cannot choose safety on their own. They depend on adults to act when danger is highest. Freedom is not a word painted in an end zone. It's safety, dignity and the chance to grow up without fear. Your donation right now helps fund prevention programs, strengthen intervention efforts, and protect innocent lives from trafficking and abuse.It turns high-risk moments into moments of defense and hope.

name: Ernest Lineberger
subject: Update from Ernest Lineberger, February 5, 2026 ​
body:
[image: image.png]

Hi Friends of Lineberger for US Congress!

WOW!!! The Voters are coming out in support of Democrats who are lining up
to work for affordability, healthcare, and quality of life issues for the
working and middle class. The authoritarian overreach will have to deal
with strong Democrats working for the people. Welcome to 2026. We have a
lot of reasons to be concerned about what is happening today, but also many
reasons to be hopeful for the future... SO LET’S WIN THIS ELECTION.

I’m ‘fully in’ as your Democratic Candidate for U.S. House (Texas CD26)
with my time, talents, energy and personal financial support. *I need your
help* with donations to help fund continued voter outreach efforts to
increase our name recognition and win more voters. I need your help
sharing our story with friends, neighbors and social media contacts. *I
need your vote* in the coming primary election (February 17-27, and March 3
rd), and another 250,000 votes in the November general election. This
won’t be easy, but it is critical to the future we pass down.

Please donate and join our Volunteer Campaign Force using our campaign
website: LinebergerforUScongress.com
<https://www.linebergerforuscongress.com/>.

While you are there you can also *visit our events* page and see what major
activities we have coming soon. You can explore the blog and other pages
to learn more about me and our campaign. You can also preview my book to
learn more detail about my history and philosophy at
https://www.amazon.com/There-Was-Memories-Ernest-Lineberger-ebook/dp/B0FP141L57

In just about 10 days, I’m excited to have our second episode of ‘Ernest
Conversations’ with several other Democratic candidates in an in-person and
online forum to help you see, learn about and interact with Democratic
candidates.

On February 15th, Ernest Conversations Episode 2 will be hosting Vikki
Goodwin, a four term Texas House Representative now running for Texas Lt.
Governor. Plus another guest Keenen Colbert, Veteran and Democratic
Candidate for Texas Senate (SD2). Our Main topic will be Immigration
Issues. This event will be available online, but also in person in
Lewisville at the Lewisville Grand Theater, Dance Recital Hall, 100 N
Charles St, Lewisville, TX 75057.

Online: https://www.facebook.com/share/1AWnuspERV/

We plan to have meet and greet time at the Lewisville Grand Theater for
some time before and after the actual event (6-7 PM and 8-9 PM) depending
on candidate availability. So, come in-person to see the live conversation
and share the excitement in the room.
Sign up with this Mobilize link:
https://www.mobilize.us/dentondemocrats/event/896129/

So, there’s a lot going on with many, many thanks to some key volunteers
who have jumped in and really helped us pick up the pace. Volunteering is
a lot like parenting, showing up and being there is the biggest first step.

*Less than One Month until Primary Election Day 2026! Our campaign is
ready to go! Please join us and do your part.*

*Volunteer opportunities:* I have sent out emails separately to those who
have asked to be on our volunteer list. Here is the condensed version.

*Block Walking* is the number one voter engagement activity that actually
brings in voters to the campaign. It’s fun to get out and share our
positive message in our neighborhoods.
For February, we will be walking precincts near Roanoke. Dates include
Saturdays, February 7, 14, 21, and 28. Meet at Noon at the Walmart parking
lot, 1228 N US Hwy 377, Roanoke, TX 76262.. We stop at 3 PM.

Use mobilize link to sign up:
https://www.mobilize.us/dentondemocrats/event/879778/

*[image: image.png]*

*Placing Campaign signs* is a simple way to help increase name recognition,
message reach and reinforce that our campaign is asking for votes. We have
a Signup Genius where you can take responsibility to help put signs out
where they will be seen. This is in addition to signs in people’s yards,
but they are mostly the same style of signs. Easy to install!
https://www.signupgenius.com/go/805084DA8AD2DA64-61283442-lineberger#/

[image: image.png]

*Bumper Magnets:* This is a great way to help increase name recognition
and alert more voters to the upcoming election. These new and improved
magnets will last 3 to 5 years outdoors. They are all Blue on a white
background. Find me in person or send your contact information to arrange
to get one. Then you can help spread our message while you drive safely
around the district.

[image: image.png]

*Postcards:* About 6000 of our 10000 Postcards have been adopted. If you
would like to write postcards for Lineberger for US Congress, please email
back to me the number of cards you are willing to do, and how to get them
to you. Remember that this includes you providing the postage at about
$0.61 each. That can add up to $61 to mail 100, so factor that into how
many you are willing to do.

Then you write a few personal lines on each card. It can be the same on
every card or you can mix it up. You can write the name and address on
each card or use labels. Attach the postage and then return them to me.

I hope to get them in the mail by February 10th so that they have a week to
get there before early voting.

So, for now, your job is to reply to me with how many postcards you can
manage. Thanks!

*What’s Next?*

The Primary election is March 3, 2026 with early voting starting February
17, 2026 (~37 days away). We are going to push hard in the primary season
to take every opportunity to get our message out.

Poll Greeting

We want to have a presence at the polls to show people that we care and
will be there for them. We have so many polling places and so many days,
we can’t cover it all, but come out and help (even for one hour). It’s fun
and addictive. Find your nearest polling place, grab a yard sign and a
friend, and go be visible outside the polling place. We must be polite and
stay outside the 100-foot line from the door to the polling place. I’ll be
doing what I can at the Carrollton Library polling location at Hebron and
Josey.

[image: image.png]

And more positive news, we were endorsed again by the Texas AFL-CIO as
their candidate to work for the needs of working Texans!

Some of you have posted something positive about our campaign on social
media. This helps so much. When I post it goes to the same people. When
you post or share my post, it helps extend our message reach and builds
name recognition needed for November. It doesn’t have to be fancy. Just a
picture of my yard sign and your personal words of support. Have fun with
it.

Thank you so much for your continued support! We are building to make the
2026 election fall in the favor of the people.

One Community – Not Divided.

Putting People’s Needs First,

Ernest Lineberger

Democratic Candidate for US House of Representatives (Texas CD26)

LinebergerforUScongress.com <http://linebergerforuscongress.com/>

To unsubscribe simply reply “stop” to this email address

Use mobilize link to sign up: [image: image.png] Placing Campaign signs is a simple way to help increase name recognition, message reach and reinforce that our campaign is asking for votes. We have a Signup Genius where you can take responsibility to help put signs out where they will be seen. This is in addition to signs in people’s yards, but they are mostly the same style of signs. Easy to install! [image: image.png] Bumper Magnets: This is a great way to help increase name recognition and alert more voters to the upcoming election. These new and improved magnets will last 3 to 5 years outdoors. They are all Blue on a white background. Find me in person or send your contact information to arrange to get one. Then you can help spread our message while you drive safely around the district. [image: image.png] Postcards: About 6000 of our 10000 Postcards have been adopted. If you would like to write postcards for Lineberger for US Congress, please email back to me the number of cards you are willing to do, and how to get them to you. Remember that this includes you providing the postage at about $0.61 each. That can add up to $61 to mail 100, so factor that into how many you are willing to do. Then you write a few personal lines on each card. It can be the same on every card or you can mix it up. You can write the name and address on each card or use labels. Attach the postage and then return them to me. I hope to get them in the mail by February 10th so that they have a week to get there before early voting. So, for now, your job is to reply to me with how many postcards you can manage. Thanks! What’s Next? The Primary election is March 3, 2026 with early voting starting February 17, 2026 (~37 days away). We are going to push hard in the primary season to take every opportunity to get our message out. Poll Greeting We want to have a presence at the polls to show people that we care and will be there for them. We have so many polling places and so many days, we can’t cover it all, but come out and help (even for one hour). It’s fun and addictive. Find your nearest polling place, grab a yard sign and a friend, and go be visible outside the polling place. We must be polite and stay outside the 100-foot line from the door to the polling place. I’ll be doing what I can at the Carrollton Library polling location at Hebron and Josey. [image: image.png] And more positive news, we were endorsed again by the Texas AFL-CIO as their candidate to work for the needs of working Texans! Some of you have posted something positive about our campaign on social media. This helps so much. When I post it goes to the same people. When you post or share my post, it helps extend our message reach and builds name recognition needed for November. It doesn’t have to be fancy. Just a picture of my yard sign and your personal words of support. Have fun with it. Thank you so much for your continued support! We are building to make the 2026 election fall in the favor of the people. One Community – Not Divided. Putting People’s Needs First, Ernest Lineberger Democratic Candidate for US House of Representatives (Texas CD26) LinebergerforUScongress.com <> To unsubscribe simply reply “stop” to this email address

| | Charlie Kirk lived fast. And he lived loud.

He filled arenas. He lit a fire in the next generation on campus.

He confronted lies and spoke truth with boldness.

And he built a movement and a machine that few ever thought possible.

I saw it up close -- _Charlie moved at a pace most couldn 't keep up with. _

But in the middle of all the noise... he made a quiet decision that changed everything.

_**He started observing the Sabbath. **_

Not as a box to check. Not as a religious performance.

_But as an act of obedience. _

As a way of saying, **_" God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold." _**

Every week -- no matter what -- Charlie stopped.

He turned off the noise. He stepped away from the battlefield.

No email. No media. No work.

He gave his full attention fully to God, his wife Erika, and his children.

It was hard at first -- for someone who carried so much.

But over time, it changed him.

And before he was assassinated, he wrote a book about what he had learned...

He gave his full attention fully to God, his wife Erika, and his children. It was hard at first -- for someone who carried so much. But over time, it changed him. And before he was assassinated, he wrote a book about what he had learned... This was Charlie's final message. His final act of trust. A book not about politics... but about peace. It 's called: Stop, in the Name of God. Peter, like I mentioned, this isn't a political book. It's not a culture war manifesto. It's a call to stop. To rest. To breathe. To return to God. Because Charlie believed America hadn 't just forgotten truth... It had forgotten trust. Trust that the world keeps spinning when you step away. Trust that God is in control. Trust that rest is not weakness -- it's worship. In Stop, in the Name of God, you'll discover: 🔥 How Charlie reclaimed the Sabbath in a world built on burnout 🔥 What sacred rest gave back to him -- as a father, husband, and believer 🔥 Why he believed this message could spark revival in a restless generation Charlie wrote this book because he knew what it meant to nearly lose his peace -- and what it felt like to find it again. That's the heartbeat of his final message. Charlie Kirk didn't waste his time on earth. He left behind a family. He left behind a movement. And he left behind this truth... For anyone ready to step off the treadmill... and walk back toward what's eternal. Peter, thank you -- in advance -- for helping reach the next generation with truth, faith, and moral courage. These are the very things Charlie gave his life for. May the message he left behind lead you -- just as it led him -- to a deeper trust in God... A stronger love for your family... And a renewed peace in your own soul. For Charlie, Justin Streiff Chief Operating Officer Turning Point USA P.S.Stop, in the Name of God is Charlie Kirk's final message -- written in obedience, shaped by Scripture, and grounded in trust in the Lord. 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. body: | | | | --- | | --- February 5, 2026 --- ## Private Property Assistance Application Deadline Extended to Feb. 28 The City of St. Louis has extended the deadline to apply for private property assistance from Feb. 14 to **Feb. 28** to give residents more time to complete applications and receive help correcting missing or incomplete information. The City will continue removing tornado debris placed by the curb until **Feb. 28.** _**Private property assistance includes:**_ * Stabilization * Repair work up to $50,000 * Demolitions and debris removal Applying early is strongly encouraged. Many applications require additional documentation or follow-ups, and submitting early ensures recovery staff has time to review applications and work with residents before the final deadline. Peter,

NOW: I’ve sent a letter [https://www.kqed.org/news/12072244/no-ice-at-super-bowl-democrats-demand-as-rumors-swirl] to Noem, with support from 21 of my fellow California representatives, demanding assurance that ICE and other immigration enforcement personnel be banned from the Super Bowl.
I refuse to allow Trump’s standing army to continue terrorizing our communities. That’s why I’ve introduced a 10-point resolution to hold ICE accountable and reform immigration enforcement:
✅ Vote no on the DHS funding bill.
✅ Repeal the multi-year $75 billion funding for ICE.
✅ Impeach Noem and Bondi.
✅ End qualified immunity for ICE agents.
✅ Investigate and prosecute every single ICE agent who broke the law.
✅ End the Kavanaugh stops with racial profiling and the militarization of ICE.
✅ Codify a use-of-force standard so courts can enforce the law against rogue ICE agents.
✅ Tear down and replace ICE with an agency that has oversight.
✅ Prohibit masks and mandate body cameras and visible identification for immigration officers.
✅ Establish human rights standards at immigration detention facilities.
Nearly 250,000 people have signed in support so far. We need to ensure that every Democrat demands these reforms. No caving or settling for less.

| | Dear Friend,

Here's a story I'll never forget, once I learned the truth behind it.

In 1917, a small group of revolutionaries led by Vladimir Lenin seized power in Russia. They promised a better, fairer world...sound familiar?

But soon after taking control, they began rounding up and executing anyone who stood in their way. Lenin even ordered his followers to hang landowners and seize their crops--so that for miles around, "people see, and tremble..."

Marxism began with promises of a perfect world--and ended in fear, famine, and death.

You may be familiar with that dark history, but too many Americans aren't. How do I know?

Because a century later, these dangerous ideas have been repackaged and rebranded. They're taught in schools and promoted by celebrity politicians using words such as "equity," "diversity," and "social justice."

The words sound harmless, but the ideas behind them are the same. Will they end up with the same terrifying results?

That's why Hillsdale College has created the National Quiz on Marxism, Socialism, and Communism, and I'd love for you to take it.

You can complete your National Quiz on Marxism, Socialism, and Communism using this secure link:

[https://info.hillsdale.edu/marxism-quiz-tf](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/s/c/H0Hpy8qO3NB4bQKeNNjI4YxYmweD4JJfhlsdHWfdPb_AZoxcYK16JkF-3fe4xNU0SQHfD3nqizvKAQCQGXxJquFpT34aHBIHOCK9U-VKFexgoQH7co60WcfUxMOnkHKzJvFwB6Lcm7lW3xsHsVWY40fb_2tEQ370rJbvN9pu430EBVSPsNX0_PE0qy3lgIYX_1cHP88E_GDwo7zC9VY2G7HOl58_MATBreLClSl3XEnsNPrWCctMkm00eHbo8j3011wFWFupZooOWvQFoIVhfqJmRsUC3W9MwTusUr9D5E39hq13cMlnPOBzSn6lDcgKAARWYGzZDhu4jCkUtaUhMZPViAQsl5DDodwS-LtelaewNHWOsuq7FGwhXO4YNiL4XbXdm6GTjO5P9Hyqan1cd2lLu_07TIpUMgqf8ed_ma8C54xsofYB4ckRyKKFPcsSt0GwEYDS3FBqiOejcOFcgs52Zaniu6PJpATASeKC-fDtnwgNPS88uqg_XW8FSAEIKyDZGY61ygTNEYZZS8IgRo52wMwsMucEJs768rRwNGCot4cUBKFhEb1RsCEkfm6H5bs_skF0ZN-QA7Uh4FtDYqpELlK6ZCXTJfcAtM2BOUTrJB_bfoAvxXMJ-hqLpZrLFXTGjEVv4nSBEx3YlfxZKGx_b8rHePbr7Ou3-lcfwBOmLkJW0fT0YQ_0Cvk6Bdxpv0HE/UqpjXGxm0nSEBhg5IPXgicWNrXEx4dqW/17)

And when you finish, we'll email you the answers, and you can watch our free online documentary-style course, "Marxism, Socialism, and Communism," which tells the whole story--from Lenin's Red Terror to today's Cultural Marxism.

Most young Americans have never learned this history. I know I didn't in high school. But you can help change that with your financial support today.

# Green Withdraws from CD-01 Race
---
| | After much prayer and careful consideration, I have decided not to seek the Republican nomination for Congress in Indiana's 1st District in 2026.
Indiana's legislature sadly chose not to redistrict Indiana congressional map to counter Democrats' egregious gerrymandering and their counting of illegal immigrants in the census. IN-01 remains an extremely difficult seat for a Republican to compete in and win. With your help, we ran a strong race in 2022 and put this district on the map. Having been through it once, I understand the harsh reality: to win this seat, there is no margin for error.
We will only win when we are unified in our vision as Republicans. We are in a midterm environment that history tells us will be challenging, as well as a district where even President Trump fell just short in 2024. As a leader, I am not afraid to lead. I am not afraid of completing difficult tasks. I am not afraid to combat poor ideas, but I must act with great wisdom before leading a team into the battle for the heart of our country, when our own teammates have proverbially tied our hands behind our back.
We will eventually flip this seat. It will require unity and a shared vision. I am committed to developing both, as God leads.
I am deeply grateful to everyone who supported and encouraged me in 2022 and again as I explored this race. You gave generously and your confidence in my ability to serve has meant more than I can express. I cherish each friendship I've made along the way.
I will stay in touch and keep you posted on what's next. I look forward to helping our party to victory in races up and down the ballot this fall.
God bless! - JRG

Indiana's legislature sadly chose not to redistrict Indiana congressional map to counter Democrats' egregious gerrymandering and their counting of illegal immigrants in the census. IN-01 remains an extremely difficult seat for a Republican to compete in and win. With your help, we ran a strong race in 2022 and put this district on the map. Having been through it once, I understand the harsh reality: to win this seat, there is no margin for error. We will only win when we are unified in our vision as Republicans. We are in a midterm environment that history tells us will be challenging, as well as a district where even President Trump fell just short in 2024. As a leader, I am not afraid to lead. I am not afraid of completing difficult tasks. I am not afraid to combat poor ideas, but I must act with great wisdom before leading a team into the battle for the heart of our country, when our own teammates have proverbially tied our hands behind our back. We will eventually flip this seat. It will require unity and a shared vision. I am committed to developing both, as God leads. I am deeply grateful to everyone who supported and encouraged me in 2022 and again as I explored this race. You gave generously and your confidence in my ability to serve has meant more than I can express. I cherish each friendship I've made along the way. body:
We’ve stood up to bullies before. We can do it again.

[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/124793938/599721863/-1473932214?refcode=logo&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83MjY1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNWE0Njk4Yi1iYzAyLWYxMTEtODMyZi0wMDBkM2ExZjBlNGMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lZXaGlYxoa3xSXbfrF1fGg4YaGJaszgzyOLcrNq8GmI=) Growing up as the youngest of four kids, more than anything, I was fighting for my voice to be heard. During our family’s dinner-table conversations, I couldn’t get a word in edgewise. At school, I was your typical geek with thick glasses and a funny last name. All this to say, I know what it's like to get picked on. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/124793939/599721871/1720001450?amounts=5,15,25,50,100&refcode=email_020526_bullies&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83MjY1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNWE0Njk4Yi1iYzAyLWYxMTEtODMyZi0wMDBkM2ExZjBlNGMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lZXaGlYxoa3xSXbfrF1fGg4YaGJaszgzyOLcrNq8GmI=)
_That’s me when I was just 5 years old!_ I also know how to stand tall when it matters. **And right now, we need to stand tall.** For months, Donald Trump has taken his grievances out on Colorado. He threatened to rip away child care resources from our state and nation, announced plans to dismantle the National Center for Atmospheric Research (NCAR), and denied disaster relief to Coloradans recovering from wildfires and flooding. He even vetoed a unanimously-passed bipartisan bill that would bring clean water to 50,000 rural Coloradans. Why? Because Colorado refuses to bend to his will and release Tina Peters, a convicted felon who is in prison for trying to interfere with the 2020 election. In other words: Trump’s picking on us. **But Coloradans have made it clear that we won’t be intimidated by the bully in the White House. We’re fighting back with every tool we have to save NCAR, protect child care, demand disaster relief funding, and stand up to Trump’s mob boss tactics.** **_[This November is our best chance to take back the Senate and send a message to the President: Colorado won’t be bullied. Peter,
